# foreman_user (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_user" "jdoe" {
  name = "jdoe"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the user to look up.

### Read-Only

- `admin` (Boolean) is an admin account
- `auth_source_id` (Number)
- `default_location_id` (Number)
- `default_organization_id` (Number)
- `description` (String)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `firstname` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `lastname` (String)
- `locale` (String) User&#39;s preferred locale
- `login` (String)
- `mail` (String)
- `mail_enabled` (Boolean) Enable user&#39;s email
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Required unless user is in an external authentication source
- `timezone` (String) User&#39;s timezone
- `ui_compact_mode` (Boolean) Use compact UI
